question: On cases failed by both 8k states, does reference state-case information within the four-observation common grade improve fresh-future predictions beyond the specified M0 grade and state-specific monotone curves, alongside fresh-future same-minus-cross overlap replication?
eligibility: parent/task case with J8=0 for BOTH prefixes; frozen by pre-confirmation outcomes

learning_proposal.rng_only_change_contract: preserve learner/targets/optimizers/entropy/replay/collector counters/generated schedule blocks/cursor/absolute steps; replace active Python/NumPy/Torch/reset/future-schedule RNG only
learning_proposal.evaluate: same per-parent O100, all 4 tasks, deterministic policy, up to 500 steps per episode, original termination rules

primary_D.pair_T: m-n_a*n_b/N within parent/task common-failure set; N=0 contributes zero
primary_D.unit: pp of original all-four-task parent/case slots; NOT success-rate gain

models.fit_separately_within: parent x task x common-failure population; no sharing case indices across parents
models.common_difficulty: c_i = number of successes across both states and both reference futures, in {0,1,2,3,4}; not true latent difficulty
models.M0: state-specific nondecreasing probability over occupied c bins, fit using PAVA with one pseudo-success and one pseudo-failure per occupied bin per state
models.M1_direction: h_i = k_1i/2 - mean_{j:c_j=c_i}(k_1j/2); state1 shifts +h, state2 shifts -h
models.M1_bound: lambda_c=min(0.25, all positive probability-bound ratios for both state shifts); zero direction gives zero shift; no endpoint tuning
invariants: each case's two-state mean equals M0
models.interpretation: incremental reference state-case information beyond THIS specified common-score monotone comparator; not elimination of every latent-difficulty explanation

primary_prediction_score.metric: binary Brier squared error (p-y)^2; smaller is better
primary_prediction_score.parent_score: mean over eligible DC+PU cases pooled within parent, 2 states and 2 confirmation futures
primary_prediction_score.overall: equal mean over 5 parents; no independent-case SE
primary_prediction_score.gain: G=BS(M0)-BS(M1); positive favors extra state-case information
primary_prediction_score.empty_parent_rule: if parent has no eligible DC/PU cases, primary investment gate is not evaluable; do not silently drop or substitute
secondary: G separately on future3 and future4
primary_prediction_score.task_weights_within_parent: N_pt/N_p, not equal task weights; empty task contributes no observations and its conditional score is NA
primary_prediction_score.case_scope: all 548 eligible DC/PU cases, including zero-correction cases; do not restrict denominator to 49 changed cases

uncertainty.case_resampling: within parent/task/joint (J0,J8_1,J8_2); same index multiplicities for all states, reference-derived predictions and new futures; no model refitting
uncertainty.case_interval: pointwise 2.5/97.5 percentile linear; conditional on fixed reference fits, histories and new trained policies
uncertainty.parent_bootstrap: all 3125 ordered parent draws with both states and all futures kept together; descriptive
uncertainty.leave_one_parent_out: remove entire parent, recompute equal remaining-parent mean with predictions unchanged
uncertainty.future_variance_limitation: two fresh futures do not precisely estimate within-state future variance; case intervals do not include it
uncertainty.case_bank_generalization: known O100 cases, not unseen-case validation

proposed_investment_gate.if_uncertain: record inconclusive; no automatic new futures, parents, thresholds or models
proposed_investment_gate.if_D_replicates_but_G_does_not: do not claim all simple explanations sufficient; only specified extra information not supported
proposed_investment_gate.small_increment_conclusion: upper uncertainty bound for G below 0.001 supports small increment only for this comparator/predictor; not global absence
proposed_investment_gate.positive_but_below_size_threshold: If a conditional interval lower bound is positive but D<0.10pp or G<0.001, report positive conditional evidence and observed size below investment threshold; hold further investment
proposed_investment_gate.positive_but_robustness_gate_failed: Report positive conditional evidence with parent concentration or future-direction limitation; hold investment, do not relabel as no effect
proposed_investment_gate.leave_parent_out_interpretation: excludes sole dependence on any one parent for that aggregate; does not demonstrate broad replication across parents
proposed_investment_gate.missing_confirmation: not executed/not measured, not failed or null scientific result

before_execution: fix finite parent count and total budget from parent/future uncertainty and funding, not case-bootstrap width alone
freeze one pre-continuation state-condition definition or explicitly decline subgroup claim
validate state restoration and gate analysis

paper_scope.primary: starting-state-associated acquisition patterns; any incremental predictive claim is relative to the explicitly specified common-grade M0 only
paper_scope.causal_intervention: optional later, only one justified factor with separately fixed design
completion_evidence: fresh-future predictive comparison against the specified grade/monotone M0, not elimination of all common latent-difficulty models
scope or reproducible boundary on new parents/states

claim_scope.positive_G: M1 improves new-future Brier prediction relative to THIS M0: total reference successes graded 0..4 plus separately fitted parent/task/state monotone curves
does_not_establish: exclusion of all common latent-difficulty explanations
state-dependent reversal of latent case difficulty ranks
an online 8k selector or allocation improvement
claim_scope.remaining_explanation: within-grade reference state allocation may carry additional information about unobserved common case difficulty under different state response curves, despite both mean-preservation constraints
claim_scope.current_support: primary M0/M1 differences occur only in PU for parents 41011,41013,41015; G cannot test incremental information in DC or other parents where forecasts are identical

prediction_feasibility_audit.inputs: locked prediction CSV only; no F3/F4 labels
prediction_feasibility_audit.observation_upper: max(gain(y=0),gain(y=1)); attained algebraically by y=1 if d>0 and y=0 if d<0
prediction_feasibility_audit.aggregation: mean over two state rows within each parent's pooled eligible DC/PU cases, then equal parent mean; same forecasts on both future labels
required_outputs: probability bounds and both mean constraints
overall and all five leave-one-parent-out lower/upper bounds
prediction_feasibility_audit.interpretation: label-space bound only, neither forecast nor power analysis nor guarantee of joint D/interval/investment gate feasibility under real learned policies
